commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: The one who cut off the five desires that work through the senses of body, mouth, eyes, nose and ears taught a true path of conduct. Those who never stray from it live for all time, free of birth and unchanging. There are five desires because there are five sense objects. Couplets 3 to 6 say that those who think of the Lord, praise him and keep to his path gain release.
